Constructor initializes aarVisible/aarViewed only if unset, disabling automatic buttons only on PC, creates safe-area/ready/damage/chat/objective/results/scoreboard/hint/wheel/PC widgets. ReadyEvents scriptNotify dispatches hero_weapon_received/killstreak_received/levelup helpers; objective ShowNotification defaults are AlwaysFalse. MPHintText nonempty predicate and nonnil text link make this shared MP-named child usable on WZ. Sprays Visible requires held button plus no prematch-hide/last-stand/inventory/multi-pickup/remote/vehicle/demo/dead [excerpt; exact source record identified separately]
